title: Command API
what: The words of bmo-cache-warmer: the service's arguments, and the mcp, health, snapshot and verify steps with their exit codes, as docs/api.md states them and deploy/systemd runs them.

title: Published client
what: The client module the package publishes: one method for each route, the wire bodies, and a refusal as its status, code and sentence, for another unit that calls the warmer.

title: HTTP API
what: The warmer's boundary over HTTP: its routes and event stream, the bearer token, pages and refusal codes, and the target-ping hook it posts to, as docs/api.md and docs/openapi.json state them.

title: Harness plugin API
what: The bmo-cache-warmer plugin: the MCP server bmo-cache-warmer mcp starts, its six warmer tools and their answers, and the skill telling a harness when to use them.

title: Schedule crate API
what: The crate bmo-cache-warmer-schedule at schedule/: the due rule, the pass plan, the switches and the reason cut as plain values, with no dependency of any kind, which a consumer may take alone.
